name: @cver/coral-repo-facts
description: REEF with Repo Facts — keeps the repository cards a page already has honest: each card's "Updated …" line is recomputed from the repo's last push, and an archived repo gets an archived pill. Client (repo-facts.js) is BUILT from repo-facts-client.mjs + repo-facts-core.mjs; the edge worker (repo-facts-worker.mjs) reads one hard-coded owner's public listing once a day and returns four checked fields per repo (name, pushed_at, archived, stars) and no free text. Version covers the UNIT: client JS + worker contract + the data-* attribute API + the renderer class names it reads.
